title: Case I: If the DB is a Root Node

blocks.content: Case I: If the DB is a Root Node
If the DB is a root node, we simply replace the DB with a single black node.

blocks.alt: Replace DB with a Single Black Node

blocks.content: This will maintain the black depth property by decreasing the black length of the whole tree by 1.
